battle.name: 剡家灣之戰
battle.theater: 秦州北渭北高原劉家圈
battle.brief: 紹興十一年（一一四一年）九月，金右副元帥完顏杲遣統軍蒲察胡盞、完顏習不主率五萬餘眾據秦州東北，圖南下入川。川陝宣撫副使胡世將命右護軍都統制吳璘率二萬八千自河池北上反擊，九月十六日破秦州。吳璘夜襲劉家圈，於剡家灣布疊陣，長槍、弓弩分層射擊，火炬照陣、輕騎誘敵，大破金軍。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是金朝與南宋在秦鳳、熙河一路的兩套軍事體系。金方以都元帥完顏宗弼為總樞紐，紹興十年（一一四〇年）五月奉金熙宗之命毀約南侵，各路兵馬先在都元帥府所在的祁州校閱；攻入陝西的西路軍由右副元帥完顏杲率領，一一四一年八月更派統軍蒲察胡盞、完顏習不主率五萬餘眾據秦州東北，兵以女真本部騎兵為主，並雜有河北、河東降附的漢軍與歸順部落，另設漢人官吏與屯田以供糧秣。宋方是川陝宣撫司系統：宣撫副使胡世將坐鎮河池，節制川陝四路軍馬；右護軍都統制吳璘領右護軍為前鋒主力，川陝宣撫使司都統制楊政屯和尚原、寶雞一線，樞密院都統制郭浩自商州向東策應，另有秦鳳、熙河各路民兵與關中、河東受聯絡的義軍首領數十人游擊敵後。川陝一線北倚長城關隘、南抵蜀口，兩軍沿渭水、汧水與秦嶺北麓對峙。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Jin state and the Southern Song, each with its own military system along the Qin and Xi circuits. On the Jin side the overall pivot was the Grand Commander Wanyan Zongbi, who in the fifth month of the tenth year of Shaoxing, that is 1140, won the Jin emperor's approval to tear up the truce with Song and retake Henan and Shaanxi; he first mustered and inspected the various columns at Qizhou, the seat of the Commander-in-Chief's office, and broke the custom of campaigning only in autumn, striking in high summer instead. On the thirteenth of the fifth month the western column led by the Right Vice-Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Gao crossed the Yellow River west of Hedong and entered Tongzhou, broke open Chang'an and pressed up to Fengxiang prefecture. In August 1141 Wanyan Gao sent the commanders Pucha Huzhan and Wanyan Xibuzhu with more than fifty thousand men to occupy the north-east of Qinzhou and prepare to march south into Sichuan. The Jin host was essentially cavalry, drawn from the Jurchen tribal levies and mixed with Han Chinese units recruited from Hebei and Hedong and with surrendered contingents, and supported by Han officials and garrison farms for grain. On the Song side the apparatus was the Chuan-Shaan pacification commission: the vice commissioner Hu Shijiang sat at Hechi and exercised control over the four circuits of Sichuan and Shaanxi; the Commander-in-Chief of the Right Guard, Wu Lin, led the Right Guard as the striking force; the commission's commander Yang Zheng held the line at Heyuan and Baoji; the Grand Commander of the Privy Council, Guo Hao, drove eastward from Shangzhou as a covering force; and dozens of local irregular leaders in Shaanxi and Hedong, contacted from the rear, harried the Jin rear areas. The Song front ran along the Wei and Jian rivers and the northern foot of the Qinling, with the great passes to the north and the road into Sichuan at its back.
people: 南宋方面，居首功者是右護軍都統制吳璘。吳璘在紹興九年吳玠病逝後總攬右護軍，力主不棄關陝、反而北上反擊；他在戰前親自察看劉家圈一帶地形，決定上原列陣以避金騎自高處俯衝，又設書致金將蒲察胡盞、完顏習不主假稱次日決戰，深夜命姚仲、王彥等各率所部銜枚潛行越嶺，並遣張士廉由間道迂迴原後斷其退路，又以輕騎誘敵出營、指揮兩翼騎兵包抄。川陝宣撫副使胡世將是全線指揮者：他以二萬八千之眾委吳璘北上反擊，收復秦州、隴州之圖皆出其手，並遣人聯絡陝西、河東義軍首領數十人襲擾金軍後方；楊政出和尚原攻隴州、燒金營寨十餘處，郭浩自商州東進連破虢州、陝州金營寨，西和州巡檢元成則向鞏州佯動以牽制熙州、河州金軍。守將武誼以秦州降宋，使宋軍得以續戰。金方以右副元帥完顏杲居中策應，統軍蒲察胡盞恃勇出戰，完顏習不主力主固守不戰而不被採納，都元帥完顏宗弼則是金人毀約南進的決策者。
peopleEn: On the Song side the man who earned the credit was Wu Lin, Commander-in-Chief of the Right Guard, who had taken overall command of that army after Wu Jie fell ill and died in the ninth year of Shaoxing. Wu Lin argued that the Song should not abandon Guanzhong but should march north and counter-attack. He personally reconnoitred the ground around the Jin camp at Liujiaquan, decided to fight on the plateau so that the Jin cavalry could not charge down upon him, and sent a letter to Pucha Huzhan and Wanyan Xibuzhu falsely announcing a duel for the next day. That same night he ordered Yao Zhong, Wang Yan and their commands to move with wrapped mouthpieces through the fog and the dark, to cross the ridge and climb onto the plateau, while he sent Zhang Shilian by a side track to swing round behind the plateau and cut the Jin retreat; the flanking column came late, and that was the one flaw in the plan. Hu Shijiang, vice commissioner of the Chuan-Shaan pacification office, was the theatre commander: he entrusted Wu Lin with twenty-eight thousand men for the northern counter-stroke, and the plan to retake Qinzhou and Longzhou came from him; he also sent men to dozens of irregular leaders in Shaanxi and Hedong to strike at the Jin rear. Yang Zheng moved out of Heyuan against Longzhou and burned more than a dozen Jin camps around Wushan, while Guo Hao drove east from Shangzhou, breaking Jin camps at Huozhou and Shanzhou in turn, and the patrol officer of Xizhou, Yuan Cheng, made a feint toward Gongzhou to pin the Jin troops of Xizhou and Hezhou. The garrison commander Wu Yi surrendered Qinzhou to the Song, which allowed the offensive to continue. On the Jin side the Right Vice-Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Gao was the pivot of the operation, the commander Pucha Huzhan was the one who insisted on giving battle, and his colleague Wanyan Xibuzhu argued for holding the camp but was not listened to. The Grand Commander Wanyan Zongbi was the man who had decided to break the truce and invade in the first place.
kits: 本場戰役的核心裝備是弩。宋軍疊陣的兵器層次分明：最前是長槍手，其後為強弩手，最後是神弓手；金騎逼近至百步之內由神臂弓發射，及至七十步距離才由強弩出手，形成兩層射擊的落差。十字弩這類機械弩在此類伏擊中擔當的是延遲而非壓制：弩手一發即須重新張弦上矢，輪番發射靠的是人數與間隔而非射速，所以宋軍把強弩手排在第二線，前方仍以長槍手與拒馬、水柵擋住騎兵衝鋒，待騎兵失速才放手射擊。火器之外，陣前設水柵、拒馬兩重障礙，入夜以萬炬同時燃起照明兼惑敵，金軍騎兵失去視野與縱馳的空間。兩翼是宋軍騎兵，負責追擊、包抄與遮斷退路。遠征與守備的後勤依賴渭水、汧水沿線的糧道，軍中除步卒、騎兵外另有搬運糧秣、趕造器械的役夫。金軍的長處在騎兵與機動力，弱點在攻堅時箭矢消耗大、離開水源後人馬飲水困難。
kitsEn: The weapon at the centre of this battle was the crossbow. The Song order of battle was arranged in clear layers: long-spearmen in front, strong crossbowmen behind them, and strong archers in the rear. When the Jin cavalry closed to within a hundred paces the divine-arm bows opened fire, and at seventy paces the strong crossbows were loosed, so that the two layers of shooting fell at two different distances. The mechanical crossbow, in a fight of this kind, served to delay rather than to crush: after every shot the string had to be drawn and the bolt replaced, so that the volleys of the crossbowmen depended on numbers and on staggered intervals rather than on rate of fire. That is why the strong crossbows were placed in the second line, with spear-points, caltrops and water fences still in front to break the cavalry's charge, and only loosed once the horsemen had lost their speed. Beyond the bows stood other gear: water fences and refused obstacles in front of the array, and at night a host of torches lit all at once to dazzle as much as to illuminate the enemy, robbing the Jin riders of their view and of the room to gallop. The Song cavalry held the two wings, responsible for the pursuit, the envelopment and the cutting of the retreat. Logistically the campaign ran on the grain roads along the Wei and Jian rivers, and besides the infantry and the cavalry each column carried the labouring parties who moved grain and hauled the engines. The Jin strength lay in cavalry and mobility; their weakness was heavy consumption of arrows in an assault and the difficulty of watering men and horses once they were away from the rivers.
tactics: 吳璘的戰法是典型的宋軍守勢反擊加上奇襲。劉家圈一帶金軍營寨踞高原之上，前臨高山、後控臘家城，騎兵可自原上俯衝，宋軍若在平地列陣必遭衝撞。吳璘遂決定上原：九月二十日白日致書金將，約定次日會戰，實則當夜趁天陰霧濃，命姚仲、王彥等所部銜枚禁聲、越嶺登原，兵分兩路，一部直趨原上，一路由張士廉率領從間道迂迴原後企圖斷金軍退路，後者因行程耽誤未能按時到位，成為此役最大的變數。宋軍在剡家灣擺開疊陣：前設水柵、拒馬，步軍居中，騎兵分列左右，長槍在前、強弩居次、神弓殿後。陣勢既定，萬炬同時點燃照亮原野，吳璘再派輕騎挑釁誘敵。蒲察胡盞不顧完顏習不主反對出營接戰，宋軍以弩手輪番發射，接連擊退數十次衝鋒，待金軍銳氣用盡、陣形後退，兩翼騎兵同時出擊包抄，殲其主力。金軍退入臘家城，宋軍追擊在即，恰好朝廷詔至，吳璘遂收兵。
tacticsEn: Wu Lin's method was the classic Song combination of a defensive counter-stroke and a night surprise. The Jin camp at Liujiaquan stood on a plateau, with a high mountain in front and Lajia city behind it, and their horsemen could charge down the slope; had the Song deployed on the open plain they would have been ridden down. Wu Lin therefore resolved to fight on the plateau. On the twentieth of the ninth month he sent a letter to the Jin commanders in the daytime, agreeing a duel for the next day, but in reality that night, with the sky overcast and the fog thick, he ordered Yao Zhong, Wang Yan and the rest to advance with their mouths bound and silent, to cross the ridge and climb the plateau in two bodies, one straight up the slope and one under Zhang Shilian by a side path to swing behind the plateau and cut the retreat; the latter was delayed and never arrived on time, which was the single largest variable in the battle. On the plateau at Shanjiawan the Song drew up their stacked formation: water fences and refused obstacles in front, infantry in the centre, cavalry on both flanks, spears in front, strong crossbows in the middle and the strongest archers at the rear. When the array was complete ten thousand torches were lit at once, flooding the plateau with light, and Wu Lin sent light horse out to taunt the enemy and draw them into the open. Pucha Huzhan ignored Wanyan Xibuzhu's objection and rode out to meet them. The crossbowmen fired in rotation and broke back some dozens of separate charges, and when the Jin attack faltered the Song cavalry on the two wings struck and enveloped, breaking the main body. The Jin fell back into Lajia city and the Song was in the act of pursuing when the imperial edict arrived and Wu Lin withdrew.
data: 可考數字以《續資治通鑑》與宋金雙方記載為準。一一四〇年五月十三日，金右副元帥完顏杲率西路軍自河中府西渡黃河入同州，攻破長安，直逼鳳翔府；此前吳璘曾以二萬眾在渭水南岸拒敵，於鳳翔石壁寨、百通坊一線擊退金軍。一一四一年八月，蒲察胡盞、完顏習不主率五萬餘人據秦州東北；九月，吳璘受命率二萬八千自河池北上反擊。九月初，楊政進至隴州西南吳山，燒毀金軍營寨十餘處；郭浩連破虢州、陝州金軍營寨。九月十六日吳璘軍攻破秦州，守將武誼以城降。九月十八日前後雙方在劉家圈、剡家灣對峙，九月二十日夜宋軍上原設陣，決戰當夜金軍被殺六百三十人，萬餘人投降，餘眾退入臘家城。九月二十八日朝廷詔令撤軍，戰事止於此。宋金和議則於一一四二年簽訂，陝西改歸金朝，邊界自淮河退至大散關。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on come from the Xu Zizhi Tongjian and from the records of both sides. On the thirteenth of the fifth month of 1140 the Jin western column under the Right Vice-Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Gao crossed the Yellow River west of Hedong Prefecture, entered Tongzhou and broke Chang'an, coming up hard against Fengxiang; before that, Wu Lin had held the south bank of the Wei with twenty thousand men and had beaten the Jin at Shibi village and Baitongfang in the Fengxiang area. In August 1141 Pucha Huzhan and Wanyan Xibuzhu occupied the north-east of Qinzhou with more than fifty thousand men, and in September Wu Lin was ordered to strike north with twenty-eight thousand troops from Hechi. Early in the month Yang Zheng advanced to Wushan south-west of Longzhou and burned more than a dozen Jin camp sites, and Guo Hao broke Jin camps at Huozhou and Shanzhou in succession. On the sixteenth of the ninth month Wu Lin's troops stormed Qinzhou and the garrison commander Wu Yi surrendered the city. The two sides then faced one another at Liujiaquan and Shanjiawan from around the eighteenth of the ninth month; on the night of the twentieth, after the Song had climbed the plateau and formed up, the Jin lost six hundred and thirty men killed and more than ten thousand surrendered, and the survivors withdrew into Lajia city. On the twenty-eighth of the ninth month the court ordered the withdrawal and the fighting ended there. The Song-Jin treaty was signed in 1142, Shaanxi passed to the Jin, and the frontier moved back to the Huai river and the Dashan pass.
cause: 戰事源於金朝單方面毀約。一一四〇年五月，金熙宗採納都元帥完顏宗弼的建策，撕毀與南宋訂立的和議，決心收回已歸還宋朝的河南、陝西；完顏宗弼先在祁州集結校閱各路兵馬，不循秋季出兵的舊例，於盛夏即行南進，五月十三日完顏杲率西路軍西渡黃河、同州入關，攻陷長安，逼近鳳翔。川陝宣撫副使胡世將在河池集議，右護軍都統制吳璘反對南撤，力主北上反擊，兩軍於是渭水兩岸對峙。宋金邊界自淮河、大散關西段歸金，蜀口為南宋根本，川陝宣撫司的戰略目標是保蜀口兼圖恢復秦隴。一一四一年八月，完顏杲乘宋軍分兵之隙，派蒲察胡盞、完顏習不主率五萬餘眾據秦州東北，準備南下取蜀口；胡世將乃以吳璘為前鋒北上反擊，計畫收復秦州、隴州，同時分兵楊政出和尚原攻隴州、郭浩自商州東進策應、西和州巡檢元成向鞏州佯動牽制熙州河州金軍，剡家灣之役即在此布置下爆發。
causeEn: The war began with a unilateral repudiation by the Jin. In the fifth month of 1140 the Jin emperor accepted the proposal of the Grand Commander Wanyan Zongbi, tore up the truce concluded with the Southern Song and resolved to recover the Henan and Shaanxi territories that had already been returned to Song. Wanyan Zongbi first gathered the various columns at Qizhou, the seat of the Commander-in-Chief's office, to be inspected; disregarding the custom of campaigning in autumn, he struck in high summer, and on the thirteenth of the fifth month Wanyan Gao led the western column across the Yellow River at Tongzhou, took Chang'an and closed on Fengxiang. At Hechi the Chuan-Shaan vice commissioner Hu Shijiang gathered his officers, and Wu Lin, Commander-in-Chief of the Right Guard, opposed a withdrawal to the south and urged instead that the army march north and counter-attack; the two sides then faced one another on opposite banks of the Wei river. The Song-Jin frontier ran from the Huai river to the western end of the Dashan pass, and Shaanxi belonged to the Jin while the road into Sichuan was the foundation of the Southern Song; the strategic aim of the Chuan-Shaan pacification office was to hold the mouth of Sichuan and to recover Qin and Long. In August 1141 Wanyan Gao took advantage of the Song army being divided and sent Pucha Huzhan and Wanyan Xibuzhu with more than fifty thousand men to occupy the north-east of Qinzhou in preparation for a drive into Sichuan. Hu Shijiang therefore put Wu Lin in front for a northward counter-stroke, with the object of retaking Qinzhou and Longzhou, while Yang Zheng was sent out of Heyuan against Longzhou, Guo Hao was driven eastward from Shangzhou to support, and Yuan Cheng of Xizhou made a feint toward Gongzhou to hold down the Jin forces at Xizhou and Hezhou. The battle of Shanjiawan was the outcome of that arrangement.
impact: 剡家灣之役是紹興年間宋金川陝線上一次罕見的宋軍野戰大捷。宋軍攻下秦州、收復陝北數州，吳璘與楊政、郭浩分守關陝，蜀口一度轉危為安，關中為之聲振，宋廷亦因之加封三將、授鎮西軍、武當軍、奉國軍節度使，諸軍士氣為之一振。胡世將聯絡陝西、河東義軍首領數十人襲擾金軍後方，顯示宋方在正面失利的年月裡仍有民間武力可資利用。然而此役成果並未持久：一一四二年紹興和議成，陝西之地盡割於金，宋金邊界東自淮河、西止大散關，吳璘奉詔班師，剡家灣所收諸州縣重歸金朝，宋人經營關陝十年的努力一朝盡棄。從長遠看，此役證明川陝一線的宋軍仍具主動反攻與殲滅戰的能力，卻也顯示和議一旦訂立，一切戰果都會被政治交易抹去；宋廷此後不再圖恢復秦隴，川陝防禦退守大散關與和尚原一線，兵力與資源轉向淮東與江西戰場。
impactEn: Shanjiawan was a rare Song field victory on the Chuan-Shaan front in the Shaoxing years. The Song took Qinzhou and recovered a number of prefectures in northern Shaanxi; Wu Lin, Yang Zheng and Guo Hao took up positions in Guanzhong, the road into Sichuan was momentarily turned from danger to safety, and the whole region resounded with the news. The court rewarded the three commanders, granted them the commands of the Zhenxi Army, the Wudang Army and the Fengguo Army, and morale throughout the Song armies rose. Hu Shijiang's contacts with dozens of irregular leaders in Shaanxi and Hedong showed that even in a period of defeat the Song could still draw on local fighting men to strike at the enemy's rear. The gains, however, did not last. The Shaoxing treaty of 1142 gave all of Shaanxi to the Jin and drew the frontier back to run from the Huai to the Dashan pass; Wu Lin was ordered home, and the prefectures recovered at Shanjiawan went back to the Jin, so that ten years of Song work in Guanzhong was undone in a single stroke. In the long run the battle demonstrated that the Song army in this theatre could still mount a deliberate counter-attack and destroy an enemy force, yet it also showed that once a treaty was made every battlefield gain could be erased by a political transaction. The Song court never seriously tried to recover Qin and Long again; the Chuan-Shaan defence contracted to the Dashan pass and the Heyuan line, and men and resources were shifted towards the eastern front in Huai and the war in Jiangxi.
result: 九月二十日夜，吳璘所部越嶺上原，在剡家灣布成疊陣，萬炬齊燃照亮高原，以輕騎誘使蒲察胡盞出營。金騎衝至百步內遭神臂弓齊射，進至七十步又逢強弩激射，連攻數十次皆被壓退；金軍氣勢稍挫之際，宋軍兩翼騎兵出擊包抄，金軍大潰，戰中被殺六百三十人，萬餘人投降。蒲察胡盞、完顏習不主收拾殘部退入臘家城，吳璘乘勢進攻，圍城將破之際，朝廷詔令罷兵，指定九月二十八日班師，剡家灣之役遂止於攻城的最後一刻。宋軍雖未盡殲敵軍，卻取得秦州、隴州等城並重創金軍西線主力，使金人入川的企圖暫時落空；同一場戰役的真正結局，則由其後一年的紹興和議決定：陝西仍歸金朝，宋人退出關中。
resultEn: On the night of the twentieth of the ninth month Wu Lin's troops crossed the ridge, climbed the plateau and formed the stacked array at Shanjiawan; ten thousand torches were lit together to light up the plateau, and light horse went out to draw Pucha Huzhan from his camp. The Jin cavalry were met by the divine-arm bows at a hundred paces and by the strong crossbows at seventy, and dozens of separate charges were beaten back; when the Jin attack lost its force the Song cavalry on the two flanks struck and enveloped them, and the Jin host collapsed, with six hundred and thirty men killed on the field and more than ten thousand surrendering. Pucha Huzhan and Wanyan Xibuzhu gathered the remnants and withdrew into Lajia city, and Wu Lin pressed the attack, but just as the city was about to be taken the court's edict arrived ordering the troops to stand down, with the withdrawal fixed for the twenty-eighth of the ninth month, so the battle of Shanjiawan ended on the last step before the storming of the city. Although the Jin force was not destroyed, the Song had won Qinzhou and Longzhou and badly mauled the main body of the Jin western army, and the plan to march into Sichuan had to be abandoned for the time being. The real ending of the campaign, however, was settled by the Shaoxing treaty of the following year: Shaanxi went to the Jin and the Song withdrew from Guanzhong.
